questions.text: Mention two functions of roots in plants.
questions.referenceAnswer: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil and anchor the plant in place.

criteria.description: Absorbs water or minerals from soil.
criteria.partialCredit: Award 1 mark for a clear reference to uptake of water or minerals. Otherwise award 0.

criteria.description: Anchors or holds the plant in place.
criteria.partialCredit: Award 1 mark for a clear reference to holding the plant in place. Otherwise award 0.

correct: Roots draw up water and keep the plant fixed.

constraints: Use only the two listed criteria.
Do not count the same function twice.

questions.text: Describe where evaporation takes place and what happens to the water.
questions.referenceAnswer: Liquid water at the surface changes to water vapor.

criteria.description: Evaporation occurs at the surface of a liquid.
criteria.partialCredit: Award 1 for an explicit reference to the surface; otherwise 0.
Award 1 for describing liquid water turning into a gas or vapor; otherwise 0.

correct: At the surface, water turns into gas.
incorrect: It happens below the liquid and makes ice.

constraints: A reference to heating alone does not earn either mark.
